broad_containment_rule: The 150-light-year catalog is an exact subset of the cited 300-light-year Gaia DR3 retrieval. Its final Cartesian membership rule, rather than the former broad retrieval cutoff, decides inclusion.
final_selection_rule: At Gaia DR3 J2016.0, transform each source and TRAPPIST-1 (Gaia DR3 2635476908753563008) from RA, Dec, and reciprocal parallax into ICRS Cartesian parsecs, then retain sources whose Euclidean separation from TRAPPIST-1 is less than or equal to 45.99020906783259 pc.
limitations: This is a reciprocal-parallax display selection, not a probabilistic distance-selected census.
Gaia DR3 positions are not propagated from J2016.0 in this viewer.
Sol is a separately sourced star object from JPL Horizons, not a Gaia DR3 source record.

derivation.method: Reapply the exact reciprocal-parallax ICRS Cartesian membership rule at the 150-light-year radius using scripts/filter_trappist_catalog_radius.py.
